constraints.name: cost_material_usages_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 3 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) <= 2000)

constraints.name: cost_material_usages_unit_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM unit)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM unit)) <= 30)

constraints.name: crm_roles_name_check
